propDocs.Menubar.orientation: Horizontal uses Left/Right; vertical uses Up/Down between triggers.
propDocs.Menubar.loop: Wraps between triggers and open menus.
propDocs.Menubar.disabled: Prevents menus from opening while retaining discoverable disabled triggers.
propDocs.Menubar.modal: Shared modality for the menus: pointer, true or false.
propDocs.Menu.dismissible: Allows Escape and outside interactions to close the menu.
propDocs.MenuContent.align: Start, center or end alignment relative to the trigger.
propDocs.MenuItem.closeOnSelect: Whether a plain menu action closes the menu.
propDocs.MenuItem.disabled: Keeps the menu item discoverable while preventing activation.
